name: @martinthommesen/oc-advisor
description: OpenCode v2 plugin that lets agents consult a configurable advisor model for a second opinion.
author: Martin Lammetun Thommesen <267603464+martinthommesen@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.verify:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (!m.default?.id) { throw new Error('dist/index.js does not export a plugin') } })"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run --workspace-root lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:effect && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:dist && pnpm pack --dry-run
